officialSources.observation: Official BAPENDA Kota Surakarta SMARTGIS page states it shows geographic PBB-P2 objects and allows viewing/editing tax-map parcels. This is a city tax map; no title-cadastre status claimed.
Rendered UI exposes 'Peta Bidang', administrative layers and fields NOP/Nama WP/Alamat. Search was not submitted. Direct browser navigation timed out, so no script/service route was inspected.
Official ATR/BPN local land-office app shell requires JavaScript; no anonymous parcel endpoint is present in the reviewed text.
Two direct requests with browser headers timed out before HTTP response. No HTML or script bundle was downloaded; no query was submitted.

remainingUncertainty: Whether SMARTGIS serves polygons with fields that can be safely filtered to identifiers and geometry; whether the mapped tax objects align with cadastral plots; whether BPN's local portal has an authenticated or public map module.
nextStep: Inspect only official static JavaScript or metadata for a geometry-only service; do not submit NOP, name or address lookups or retain property records.
